title: Immunostaining of Isolated Lymphoid Follicles in Small Intestine
author: Chise Suzuki
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.jr3cm8n

steps.title: Open intestine vertically
steps.instruction: Open the small intestine longitudinally (vertically) to expose the lumen.

steps.title: Rinse intestine with cold PBS
steps.instruction: Rinse the opened intestine in a petri dish using cold phosphate‑buffered saline (PBS).

steps.title: Divide intestine into four segments
steps.instruction: Divide the small intestine into four equal segments labeled A to D from proximal to distal.

steps.title: Incubate segments on shaker
steps.instruction: Place each segment in a tube, incubate on a shaker at 37 °C for 15 min at 90 rpm, then shake the tubes vigorously 20 times by hand.

steps.title: Fix segments in formalin
steps.instruction: Rinse each segment with cold PBS, submerge it in 10 % formalin‑buffered saline, and store at 4 °C for at least 1 hour.

steps.title: Wash segments with Triton TBS
steps.instruction: Wash each segment three times, 5 min each, with TBS (50 mM Tris‑HCl, pH 7.2, 150 mM NaCl) containing 0.5 % Triton X‑100.

steps.title: Block endogenous peroxidase
steps.instruction: Add 1 % H₂O₂ in methanol to each segment and shake for 15 min at room temperature (RT).

steps.title: Avidin blocking
steps.instruction: Add 1 drop of Avidin D solution (Avidin/Biotin Blocking Kit) in 250 µL PBS containing 1 % BSA, incubate 30 min at RT, then wash the segment with TBS.

steps.title: Biotin and primary antibody incubation
steps.instruction: Add 1 drop of biotin solution (Avidin/Biotin Blocking Kit) together with 2.5 µL rat anti‑mouse CXCR5 primary antibody (clone 2G8, BD Biosciences) in 250 µL TBST; incubate overnight at 4 °C. Wash three times, 5 min each, with PBS.

steps.title: Biotinylated secondary antibody
steps.instruction: Add 2 µL biotinylated anti‑rat Ig secondary antibody (Anti‑Rat Ig HRP detection kit, Pharmingen) in 400 µL antibody diluent; incubate 30 min at RT. Wash three times, 2 min each, with PBS.

steps.title: Streptavidin‑HRP incubation
steps.instruction: Add 350 µL Streptavidin‑HRP to each segment, incubate 30 min at RT. Wash three times, 2 min each, with PBS.

steps.title: DAB color development
steps.instruction: Drain PBS, add 300 µL DAB solution (prepared as 1 drop DAB per 1 mL DAB buffer), incubate 5 min or until the desired color intensity is reached. Wash three times, 2 min each, with PBS, then rinse with water three times for 2 min each.

steps.title: Mount stained segments
steps.instruction: Mount each stained intestinal segment on a glass slide and fix with Mount‑Quick Aqueous mounting medium.

steps.title: Repeat steps 5–7 three times
steps.instruction: Repeat steps 5–7 (incubate on shaker, formalin fixation, Triton‑TBS washes) three additional times.

steps.title: Place segments in HBSS‑EDTA
steps.instruction: Transfer each segment into a 15 mL tube containing 10 mL pre‑warmed (37 °C) Hank’s balanced salt solution (HBSS) with 5 mM EDTA; keep at 37 °C.

steps.title: Remove epithelium and filter
steps.instruction: Discard the supernatant containing epithelium, then filter the remaining intestinal segment through a gauze.

steps.title: Re‑incubate in HBSS‑EDTA
steps.instruction: Return the retained intestinal segment to the 15 mL tube with 10 mL HBSS containing 5 mM EDTA.

steps.title: Final TBST washes
steps.instruction: Wash the segment three times with TBST (TBS containing 0.05 % Tween 20), 5 min each.
